newsitem.title: CANADA: RESEARCH ALERT - Newbridge raised by UBS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Newbridge raised by UBS.

text.p: UBS Securities analyst Nikos Theodosopoulos said on Friday he raised his rating on Newbridge Networks Corp to a buy from a hold.
The analyst cited "better comfort with the packet (switching) business, which showed better growth rates than we had anticipated."
In July, Theodosopoulos sent the stock into a tailspin when he cut the stock to a hold from a buy, citing concerns about high level sales force turnover and a "back-end loaded" fiscal first quarter.
Newbridge in August assuaged investor worries by beating the street with its first-quarter earnings.

An upbeat annual meeting on Thursday and a contract with Matsushita Communication Industrial Co Ltd prompted several New York analysts to issue positive reports and Theodosopoulos to change his rating.
The stock was up 2-7/8 at 64 in New York and 4.10 to 88 in Toronto.
